name: Simplify model selection to three clear paths
description: Model selection has become complex with learned heuristics, Python scripts, and multiple override points. Simplify to three clear paths: 1) --model flag, 2) FADE_MODEL env, 3) PRD complexity field. Remove the learning system for now - it can be re-added once core is stable.

userStories.title: Remove model selection learner integration from cmd_run
userStories.description: The recommend-model.py and learned heuristics add complexity. Disable them from the main loop.
acceptanceCriteria: Model selection uses only: --model flag > FADE_MODEL env > complexity field > sonnet default
fade/lib/ Python scripts remain (not deleted) but are not called from fade-cli

userStories.title: Consolidate get_model_for_complexity to single function
userStories.description: Model routing logic is scattered. Create one clear function.
acceptanceCriteria: Single get_model_for_complexity() function handles all routing
Returns model name and routing_source for logging
Function has clear comment explaining precedence
Remove duplicate routing logic from other functions

userStories.title: Add model selection test coverage
userStories.description: Create tests that verify model selection works as documented.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: missing complexity defaults to sonnet

technicalNotes.rationale: Refactoring requires understanding existing patterns. Medium complexity.
